reviews-google-yelp.name: Michael D'Alonzo
reviews-google-yelp.message: Purchased an exhaust for our 2000 Porsche Boxter S.  What a fantastic product. Sound is amazing, and the car does indeed feel a step faster. Customer service follow up was amazing and am already shopping for the next performance upgrade for our 986 Fabspeed manufacturers. Highly recommended.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Martin Engster
reviews-google-yelp.message: Great team and outstanding products.  Thank you DJ for all your help getting my Porsche 991.1 all setup and sounding amazing.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Angelo Reyes
reviews-google-yelp.message:
I have no words to express how wonderful the entire Fabspeed Team - especially Vince Dean and his tremendous advice and guidance - have been as they have helped me achieve the maximum power, sound, and performance from my 2019 Cayman S.  Vince's advice in regards to the MaxFlo Exhaust system was spot on, and the results have been amazing - an exhaust note completely unleashed (especially when in Sport Mode).

Great communication.  Prompt and most helpful responses and advice. Fabspeed has been a true gem in all respects.  Highly recommend this team.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Jonathan Cordoba (Founder CEO CarBuddy)
reviews-google-yelp.message: By far the most professional and experienced when it comes to Exotic Motorsports, Performance and Tuning. I have been to many of their shows, and have had Maserati Tuning done here! Definitely recommended as well as their Exotic Shows are a great fun time for the whole family!

reviews-google-yelp.name: Maxant Industries
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Total satisfaction! The crew at Fabspeed is top notch and makes a incredible product.
My Porsche has come alive with their new sport cats. Look forward to adding more products from Fabspeed.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Joshua Sean
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Fabspeed Motorsport embodies an all-encompassing, industry-leading, meaningful experience one would ideally envision when engaging an automotive performance company for aftermarket exhaust and performance upgrades. Their passion for designing, engineering, and manufacturing the very best in exotic car performance exhaust is not only displayed in their excellent craftsmanship and elite engineering prowess, but their dedication to the customer and the customer's happiness. After purchasing the GT450 Race Performance Package for the 981 GT4, we literally felt like we were indoctrinated into the Fabspeed family. Red carpet was rolled out for us, communication was effortless and fun, and every team member we have ever had the pleasure of working with sincerely cares about our happiness and experience. Phil and Jason have gone well above and beyond expectations to ensure we are more than satisfied with our purchase and driving experience. This isn’t so much a review, but rather a wake-up call to other companies in the aftermarket automotive industry. Fabspeed Motorsport sets the bar for performance, sound, quality, and customer service in custom exotic car performance fabrication, leading by example through tireless and discerning engineering practices and fostering true connections and relationships with their customers (extended family). I recommend Fabspeed Motorsport for exotic car performance exhaust and upgrades to anyone who values objective performance, elite quality, steadfast expertise, and an honest and true sense of community in the automotive industry. Thank you Fabspeed Motorsport for a truly one-of-a-kind, elite experience.
-Joshua (Tracking Ponies)

reviews-google-yelp.name: Dave Hogg
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Fabspeed installed their valved exhaust and custom tune on my V10 R8 last week, and the car is completely transformed. The tune is clearly superior to the "off the shelf" brand tune the car had before.

The exhaust around town with valves closed is much sportier with better "presence" than stock, yet in freeway cruising it's only slightly louder than stock, and tire noise is still audible in the cabin.

Opening the valves brings on "Hounds of Hell" mode with the next best thing to straight pipes. It's a true symphony when that V10 winds past 8K rpm. Valves-open gets attention from everyone and anyone, the good and the bad, and that's why I can close them, if I wish, by pushing the #1 button on the car's built-in garage door opener (#2 releases the Hounds once again).

reviews-google-yelp.name: Ross Velardi
reviews-google-yelp.message:
1 star: the high flow cats sound great and the carbon fiber tips look very nice on my 911.
0 stars: Nonexistent customer service, lack of accountability, shoddy workmanship.
Importantly, my 991.2 is still under warranty and I had the factory 20k/2yr  performed on 17 June 2021 at Porsche Warrington prior to Fabspeed's install. No issues were reported from that 20k.
As arranged, I arrived in person at 0930, 22 June 2021, as I lived locally. The appointment was for install of high flow cats and carbon fiber tips. In addition to the cost of parts, I had previously been billed and paid in advance  $742.00 for 4 hours of labor at $175/hr. Their time expectation for the job.
As the install passed 4 hours, more techs and more discussion near my car, still on the lift and the back end still on the ground. At least twice I asked my rep and point of contact DJ Crilly if there was a problem. Of course not.  I took possession of the car at approximately 3:30pm. 6+ hours.
From that point until early November, we became very busy selling our PA house,  buying a house in CA and moving across country.
I had tried once or twice during this period to open the back "trunk" of the car. I certainly didn't prioritize this event over other pressing matters at the time to have it immediately analyzed.
The day before the 911 was to ship to CA, I was driving the 911 to minimize the fuel in the tank for the shipment.  I passed by Porsche Warrington, making a spur of the moment decision to stop and have them look at the switch. Mike Costante, the excellent service manager, graciously had his very busy techs look at the problem. He had no idea of Fabspeed's potential involvement at the time, but he reported numerous issues with the back end. Misalignment as the probable cause of the failed actuator solenoid and severed mechanical release cable for the hatch. Total cost to yours truly: $1060.
Upon receipt of the bill, I drove the 10 minutes to Fabspeed, informed DJ of the issues with the car discovered by Porsche Warrington and upon leaving felt fairly confident that Fabspeed would reimburse the cost of the repair.
Enter Ted D'Orazio, the supposed "Customer Service Advocate" at Fabspeed.
I wrote many emails to Ted, all of which either gave amplifying information to support the correct timeline or refute Ted's false claims. Doesn't matter, according to Ted, since they weren't notified first, they have no financial responsibility. Both of his very succinct emails stated his open and shut case.
The first of 2 emails I received from Ted attempted to promote a false timeline of culpability claiming the Porsche 20k service was performed in July, well after Fabspeed's install .Essentially potentially blaming Porsche Warrington??  He based his claims on a conversation he said he had with Mike at Porsche. To verify this conversation, I called Mike and he emphatically denied telling Ted the 20k service was performed in July. Mike's response included the simple fact that he had the Jun 17 invoice right in front of him.
The second email has the true essence of the Fabspeed take on customer service.  From Ted's final correspondence that I have received to date,  it reads in part:
"I hope this email finds you well. In response to our recent communication: Regardless of the dealer, vehicle, timeline, or opinion of part failure, our previous correspondence stands. While we have no doubt you had a concern with your car, if you had any concerns with the service Fabspeed Motorsport provided, Fabspeed Motorsport should have been notified and been able to investigate the concerns prior to any repairs being performed."
No need to read between the lines in the above quote: Probably, to very likely, it WAS our fault, but you didn't give us the right of first refusal. OBTW, the above is an incredibly narrow path for customer satisfaction as written.
So...I hope this review finds them well. My wife and I are enjoying CA, and I will continue to pass on to my fellow Porsche owners and POA members just how satisfied I am with Fabspeed.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Impacting You
reviews-google-yelp.message: Cool Cars. The staff took time to show the kids around and talk to them about cars. They let the kids sit inside these cars and the work they were doing on exotic cars was amazing. They let us take pictures. It was fun experience.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Rashed AlOmran
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Amazing service, very welcoming and professional staff. Great facility they have, you can do almost anything you want to your car in their facility. Scott helped me out and got me everything I needed. Only bad thing I would say is their hourly rates are pricey, but honestly amazing job they do. 100% recommend this place to anyone with a modern European sports car.

Thanks Scott and Joe

reviews-google-yelp.name: Jesse Weaver
reviews-google-yelp.message:
So, there has been some turn over and clearly some things i wasn't aware of. Sounds similar to me being under a rock during teaching.

I've worked with Scott in the past few years and orders quite a few parts. He was very knowledgeable and helped out alot. In the beginning, I had soooooo many questions. I have a macan turbo and a boxster.
The boxster has the full deal, long tube headers, custom tune from fabspeed (mygenius), cold air intake deal and other goodies. Overall, everything is holding strong and the tune with headers really put some power back into the car. The quality seems good, and I have tried a few other products and returned them due to poor quality. Soul performance and circuit werks. Even more, when dealing with circuit werks, they bashed fabspeed, which is highly unprofessional.

I'm waiting on the macan filter, but it should work just fine. The customer service is excellent when working with Matt and Francesca. Both are good, but I really appreciate Francesca's communication with me and her passion for fabspeed.

I'm not the biggest fan of their customer service rep Ted and Dj, whom do not respond to me. However, I'm very happy dealing with Matt and Francesca.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Feraz S
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Extremely high quality product and great comms with their team. I bought the Fabspeed X Pipe and 200 cell Sports cats which have been fitted to my 1997 Porsche 993 C2S widebody for several months now and they are excellent! Firstly, they arrived in the UK carefully packaged and looking like works of art and much lighter than the stock item. The Porsche shop that fitted them for me were also very impressed with the quality and the perfect fitment.

I have combined the Fabspeed X Pipe and Sports cat with the Fister Stage I which in my mind is perfect – a more throaty cold start which settles to a nice idle and produces a more aggressive tone at higher revs and enhances the classic air cooled sound without being too loud and has zero drone. Engine responsiveness and urgency also seems to have improved.

The car sounds great and I am regularly asked for the details of the exhaust set up.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Zach Fowler
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Fabspeed earned these 5 stars. They design and deliver amazing products. They also stand behind their products. I purchased their Porsche 981 X-pipes as well as their proprietary tune. The XperTune made an immediate difference in my base Boxster (2.7 H6). It’s well worth the price in my opinion. The car is so much more fun to drive now!

My Fabspeed purchases exceeded my expectations. Joe and Justin made the tune upgrade process seamless and their customer experience and support are industry leading. Fabspeed is the only business I’ll return to for my Porsche needs if I can help it.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Louis D'Amelio
reviews-google-yelp.message: Was there for  Porsche club event. Staff was incredibly knowledgeable and helpful with my questions about track upgrades for my car. The place was as clean as an operating room. Attention to detail in their engineering and fabrication were impressive. Looking forward to having them do some work for me.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Wesley Cherry
reviews-google-yelp.message: Fabspeed did everything they could to help me with my exhaust system for my 718 GT4 (Miami Blue baby!).  Joe Torchiana was my point of contact and he was exceedingly helpful throughout the whole process.  I can’t recommend them more highly.  The exhaust sounds great and really opens up the noise given the addition of the GPF on the 718 series.  Thanks!

reviews-google-yelp.name: Vincent Rovito
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Very special thank you to DJ at Fabspeed. DJ answered my call late in the business day. We chatted about exhaust options available for my air cooled Porsche. He was very patient and knowledgeable. I told him I'd call the next day to follow up as I wanted to do more research on their products. I call the next day, speak to DJ, and settle on several performance parts for my Porsche. Best part, all items were in stock and able to be picked up since I'm local to their shop.

I arrive at the shop at the agreed upon time. Items were already packaged and ready for pick up. The cherry on top was an offer from DJ to tour the shop and see "where the magic happens." I really appreciated this and enjoyed hearing about how Fabspeed started and where it's headed. Now that I'm part of their community, I'm looking forward to attending their open houses.

I will be back in the future. Fabspeed is more than a "shop." They want to build lasting relationships with their clients while remaining on the cutting edge of product development. Kudos to the entire team.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Ryan Bean
reviews-google-yelp.message: Welcome to the jungle! My C8 Corvette with Fabspeed sport cats, full exhaust is unmatched in the game! Compliments everyday I take it out! Couldn’t be happier with the craftsmanship and service from Fabspeed Sports thank you!!!!

reviews-google-yelp.name: Tony Rotundo
reviews-google-yelp.message: Absolutely the very best customer experience I have encountered. Ted D'Orazio was extraordinary in his approach solving my relatively complex issue.  Exemplary communications and a solution that required some significant effort from Fabspeed, but for me was quite straightforward.  I cannot heap enough praise on Ted and the exceptional quality of Fabspeed products and service.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Jean Joseph Canale
reviews-google-yelp.message:
i have made the installation of the FABSPEED Sport cats and Sport headers on my 2017 Porsche 991.2 Carrera 4 cab at my Porsche Center yesterday and iam very satisfied.

Still quiet when the PSE is off and very loud in sport and sport+ mode, i like so much the backfire who are this time stronger and the turbo noise who is more noticeable.

Iam very happy of the sound a lot better of the original one, thanks you FABSPEED

reviews-google-yelp.name: Ivan N
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Horrible customer service , do not buy from them. Avoid at all costs!
UPDATE  > The point is that i was offered and guaranteed to match pricing by one of your employees. At this time i just want to send the part back and receive a refund

reviews-google-yelp.name: michael feauto
reviews-google-yelp.message: I absolutely love my new X Pipe exhaust for my Porsche Cayman. There was an issue with the new exhaust tips fitting correctly. I contacted Fabspeed and spoke with Ted. Their customer service is beyond anything I have ever experienced before. Ted shipped me a set of new exhaust tips and they fit perfectly. I've gotten many compliments on how they transform the look of the car. I will be ordering a full exhaust sometime next year and am excited it will be from Fabspeed. I recommend this company 12/10.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Jacob M
reviews-google-yelp.message: We wanted to write a review with our experience. I have been with a customer service based company for 22 years and understand what it means to go above and beyond to wow a customer and that is what Ted, Kyle ,Jason, and Gary all did. I can not put into words how grateful I am for all the help they put in to make the sign and it was beyond my expectations. Thank you so much for all your hard work and dedication to the satisfaction of your customers. You have a customer for life for all my performance needs!

reviews-google-yelp.name: Shelby LeDoux
reviews-google-yelp.message: Firstly, I want to start off by complimenting the customer service I received from Fabspeed. I worked with Gary from the beginning and he was nothing but helpful, answering all of my questions and helping me understand exactly what I wanted for my car. Once I picked out what I wanted, the ordering process was easy and the package came FAST! Install was easy and the end results were AMAZING. Simply installing their headers took my car from sounding cool to COOL!! I get so many compliments on how the car sounds and everyone is blown away to learn that I only installed headers with no tune. I could not be happier with the result, especially at a relatively low cost. THANK YOU FABSPEED!! Can't wait to work with this company again in the future.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Philip Powell
reviews-google-yelp.message: Scott K was my sales person. He responded immediately on the web and continued to deal with me on the phone. I purchased a valvetronic system for my R8 and it came out beautifully. We had a hiccup during the process where the system failed their QC process. It took an additional 3 days to get the exhaust, but the expedited it and threw in some swag for the trouble. All-in-all, these guys know how to deal with supercar customers and want to make sure that the VERY small community is well cared for. I'm incredibly happy so far and would highly recommend them.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Martin Lockhart
reviews-google-yelp.message: Rarely do you find a company that you are 100% pleased with. I purchased an X pipe and tail pipes from Fabspeed for my Porsche 991. I dealt with Joe who was absolutely fantastic, mega knowledgable, genuine and so helpful answering every question I threw at him. I received the system promptly, a perfectly hand crafted piece of kit that fitted without a hitch. It looks fantastic and sounds just perfect, not too loud but just releasing the flat six noise and noticeably allowing it to breath more easily. At highway speeds it is as quiet as standard but with a lovely tone.it just makes the whole driving experience better!  I cannot speak too highly about this company, Joe and their quality product and service. Highly recommended.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Joe Calvo
reviews-google-yelp.message: I purchased the front licence plate bracket for my F430 and couldn't be more pleased.Install time 10 minutes, fits perfectly,looks great and you don't have to drill any holes in your $10,000.00 front bumper . A Plus all the way!

reviews-google-yelp.name: John Bunch
reviews-google-yelp.message:
My 1st Porsche 911S Ownership was 1973. Having saved every dime from 1969-1973 my sole goal was to buy this incredible brand. Since pulling the trigger on my 1st 911S it has been a joy to own this Brand except years 75, 76, & 77. To date my Ownership history includes 16 Porsche 911S, 4S, and Turbo “S”
Fabspeed on any Porsche is without QUESTION the best decision you might make save marrying The Perfect Woman (which I managed to do). Fabspeed is the Gold Standard. Do not extend any credibility to Reviews who state otherwise. Google “Capt John GiddyUp Bunch” as I know how the World turns.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Jon Washington
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Purchased the Competition Intake System from Fabspeed for my 996 Carrera. Fast shipping and great quality. The fit and finish of this product is second to none. Installation took no time at all and the mod really livens up the car. When you're at 4k rpm the noise that comes from that thing is incredible. Great customer service that quickly answers any questions too.
I plan on buying headers from them this winter.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Omar Council
reviews-google-yelp.message: Great spot

reviews-google-yelp.name: Rob Bianchin
reviews-google-yelp.message:
I had heard great things about Fabspeed from others in the industry but my expectations were definitely exceeded with this project. The team at Fabspeed went above and beyond when developing and building the exhaust system for our NSX. With the pictures and video commentary, they made us feel like we were a part of the action and that isn’t an easy to do when you are 800kms away and in another country.

I know that there were many skilled hands that were involved with making this project come to life and I would like to extend our thanks to the entire team. reviews-google-yelp.name: Keith Ogasawara
reviews-google-yelp.message:
I was shopping for a performance exhaust system for my 911 when I came across the Fabspeed X-pipe. I purchased different performance exhaust systems in the past. I have purchased both European and US brands. I was considering the Borla and AFE exhaust systems when I was referred to Fabspeed by another Porsche owner.
After visiting the website and registering Joe Torchiana reached out to me.  I was surprised to have someone personally reach out to ask me what I was shopping for and offer to give me advise.  I never experienced this with any other companies.  His outstanding customer service and advice convinced me to give Fabspeed a try. The cost of the X pipe initially appeared expensive compared to a complete exhaust system from their competitors but it was worth it.
Joe’s insight was key in my decision making. He took into account the acoustics of a cabriolet.  He also informed me that Fabspeed exhaust systems are components so I could upgrade my system later if I wanted.  However he was sure the X pipe was all I needed.  So based on his recommendations and expertise I purchased the X pipe.
When I received my system I was blown away by the quality of the packaging and the attention to detail. There was a sticker indicated who packed the box. The box was sturdy and there was foam insulation protecting the product. I have never seen such attention to detail in the packaging of an exhaust system before. Most products come in a box full of dents with minimal protection of the product. Inside the box was a packing slip including a checklist of things included and some swag. Again the attention to detail was amazing.
Looking at the product itself, I see that you get what you pay for. The welds were a thing of beauty. Stickers on the product indicated what side each piece was for. Unfortunately there were no installation instructions included. Removal of the stock system was the hardest part but patience is key and you can remove the stock system with a floor lift/jack stands and without removing the bumper. The only special tool you might need is a Torx socket for the stock exhaust tips.  But you can remove these if you are careful with a metric socket.  There are YouTube videos describing the process.
Even without instructions installation was a breeze. Stickers on the parts indicated their location on the car. All hardware was included. Fitment was amazing. It fit better than the OEM system.  The quality of the product is amazing and the best I’ve ever seen. It’s so sad you can’t see it without looking under the car. It really is an engineering work of art.
Sound of the product is amazing. Idle is slightly louder than stock with a nice rumble. Highway cruising has absolutely not drone and you can barely hear the difference. Step on the gas and the flat 6 sound is amazing but not overwhelming or obnoxious. With the top down it is pure joy. Get off the gas and there are wonderful pops. Joe was right. It is amazing that just adding the X pipe and using the stock side mufflers makes such a difference. Car feels quicker and seems to rev out faster.
This is probably just an illusion and the fact that I’m on the gas a little more just to hear that beautiful sound.  According to Fabspeed the X pipe does increase horsepower and torque.  How they did that while using the stock “side cans” is beyond me.
If you haven’t tried Fabspeed yet you owe it to yourself to try them. I’ve never seen such build quality or attention to detail before in an exhaust system.  Even how they prepare and pack your product shows they really care about getting the customer a great product. I am a Fabspeed convert and will be buying Fabspeed products for all my future performance exhaust needs

I keep getting compliments from people at car shows, gas stations, and even at stoplights.

The owner Joe Fabiani is a stand up guy, and scheduled me in super early on a Wednesday morning so I could make a business meeting later in the day. The service was fast and professional, and their tech Dustin walked me through the exhaust setup on my car, and allowed me to customize my choice of tips, and assure their placement is perfectly to my liking.

I am a former employee of the company, and have seen all the ins and outs of the sales team and fabrication facility. There is nothing out of the ordinary to see, and they will give any walk in customer a full tour of the facility showing off the cool equipment that they have to produce their systems.

The recent slew of slander and distasteful reviews stem from one customer who tracked his car with a Fabspeed product not designed for the track, voided his warranty, and was stuck with the product. Fabspeed eventually made the situation right, but this customer has a reputation for slandering other businesses and throwing them under the bus for his own personal gain. Disappointed at Fabspeed and their so called “warranty” on their exhaust systems. I brought my Porsche 911 in because I found 2 cracks on my X-pipe. They put the car on a lift, called me over and told me that I have 2 cracks which I was already aware of. Then he went on to tell me that they would need to take the exhaust off and weld it which would make me pay out of pocket for labor for something that isn’t my fault. Exhaust cracked meaning there is an issue with their quality. Their warranty should have covered that but instead I was told I’d have to pay for labor and +$250 for carryover warranty since I’m the second owner of the exhaust. One guy told me the exhaust needs to come off and another told me they would weld on car. Sounded like they just wanted to charge me for labor to get some extra money. Anyway I decided not to get the job done there because it would be costing me over $500 to get a simple weld that takes 30 minutes. Ended up welding the exhaust my self since “warranty” didn’t actually exist. For anyone that is thinking about Fabspeed I can tell you two things, Quality isn’t great for the price they charge and make sure you ask about warranty because it clearly was not there with my exhaust. Disappointed but lesson learned.
Attached a before and after picture of one of the cracks.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Michael J.
reviews-google-yelp.message:
Purchased Cobb accessport with pro tune.  Pro tune has been more difficult to obtain than I expected.  Fabspeed wants specific car data, which sounds great, but how many of us have time to find a dyno or an open flat road with no other traffic to do 3 full pulls in 3rd gear?  Be honest, it's time consuming ... particularly if you have only done basic mods like intake plenum, TB and some headers or exhaust.  Not rocket science.  And Fabspeed has worked on Porsches for how long?  I went and got the data ... was easy to email over to Fabspeed and get a file back to load onto my GT4 .... problem is my dash lit up with CEL and 3 error codes that wont go away.  Went back to Cobb stage 2 map (no CEL) and am awaiting word from Fabspeed on what's next.  

Not worth the extra money over the basic Cobb device yet.

On another note ... the Fabspeed sport headers I purchased and installed are awesome.

So, overall, I'd say keep the money and get the car tuned by another shop after you put on the aftermarket bits.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Dean C.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Matt C.
reviews-google-yelp.message: Dealing with Fabspeed has been one of the biggest surprises of my life. Big name, but they do not stand behind their product. I purchased an exhaust that was somehow bent during fabrication. I sent multiple pictures to techs within the company who confirmed this was the case. Since the exhaust was already installed on my vehicle at this point, customer service agreed that if I purchased a new, different model exhaust form them, I could return this system for a full refund. The first exhaust was $1,295 - second exhaust was $1,850. Once I received the second exhaust, I mailed first exhaust back as planned. Their customer service department as well as a vice president within the company both came up with reasons why I was no longer eligible for a refund after they had my original exhaust back in their hands. Buyer beware. Great products when you get one that is correct, but if you have any issues whatsoever, good luck to you, you are on your own.

reviews-google-yelp.name: jeffrey L.
reviews-google-yelp.message: I had such a good experience with these guys, it only felt right to share. I have a 2014 Porsche Cayenne GTS and purchased a Fabspeed midpipe. During the installation, the shop I used, which was not close to home, *may* have bent the OEM hardware. The finished product gave a great exhaust note and sound, but with an ever present and annoying whistle/exhaust leak. I contacted Fabspeed not knowing the cause of the issue, and worked with Brian Jamison in service. He 1.) found a shop 3 miles from my home that they've worked with in the past to check out the car 2.) called the shop and explained my issue 3.) responded to every question I had within an hour or two 4.) discovered that the parts used for the install were OEM and not produced by Fabspeed 5.) Fabricated new, custom hardware FOR FREE and mailed them to the new shop FOR FREE 6.) struck a deal with the new install shop to handle the re-visit service cost FOR FREE 7.) Did not ask for anything in return. I haven't had this level of top service anywhere, and certainly wasn't expecting it here, but am very happy I did. Accidents happen, and it's nice when people take ownership over them. This was really above and beyond, as they were taking total ownership of a problem they did not create. They just took care of me, and are true professionals. I highly recommend them.

reviews-google-yelp.name: Ron H.
reviews-google-yelp.message:
I've been a customer and fan of FabSpeed Performance products for over 10 years now, but after seeing the new facility, felt it was time to write a review.

The lobby is AMAZING!  It's like a clubhouse with a huge comfortable sofa in front of a fireplace as well as a 80" TV.  Whatever race is one wherever; it's playing here.  There's a Redbull cooler when you walk in as well as an espresso and coffee machine...Of course, there's a few racecars sitting in the showroom to check out as well (Lamborghini, Ferrari and a Porsche Cup car the last time I was there).

There's clear garage door like windows which allow you to see into the new shop.  At the back, there's an AWD dyno used to test and tune their products.  Mandrel bending machines, welding area, water jet, laser engraver...you name it, they've got it here for production.  It's really cool to look at and see the products being handmade by their techs right infront of your eyes!

If you elect to have it installed there, there are 6+ bays and lifts to have the work done while you watch on.  Just ask, and they're more than happy to take you through the shop for a full tour. 

As for their products?  I had a 2005 Maserati Coupe that they did a full exhaust system on (Cat by-pass, x-pipe and sport muffler) and WOW did it make a difference.  Tons more torque (enough to light up the tires when there was a hard shift into 2nd and 3rd), quicker acceleration over 80MPH and the sound was music to my ears.  Seriously, I had Ferrari F430/360 owners stopping me to ask about what I did to the engine to get it to sound so throaty!  The fit and finish was perfect, never an issue, and the tops looked great and were perfectly lined up out the back bumper.

The staff here are what truly makes this shop a favorite.  "Joey" and "Alex" were a huge help in all my purchases and projects and are experts with all the fitments and options for any model.  I've referred probably 20+ friends here over the years and all have had similar experiences.  If  you're in the greater NE area, don't bother mail ordering the products, it's worth a drive down to meet the staff and have the product installed onsite!

reviews-google-yelp.name: Tony S.
reviews-google-yelp.message: I purchased the 993 RSR exhaust system for my 911 Outlaw. The build quality of the headers, muffler and connecting pipes is excellent, the fit is perfect and overall look and finish is also excellent. The sound is aggressive but much better than other systems I've had on this car, with no annoying resonance or vibration. Although much louder than stock 993 exhaust, it is not overbearing and easily liveable with even on a street driven car. I also noticed significantly smoother power deliver from the engine. Although I believe that overall horsepower is either unchanged or any increase is marginal, there is a significant improvement in how smoothly the power now comes on, much more linear, and the throttle is crisper. Overall, huge improvement over the prior system, which was a custom build based on a Magnaflow dual in, dual out muffler. The only reason I am not giving 5 stars is due to significant delay in delivery of the system after it was ordered, with minimal contact or explanation from the company about the delay. After I called a couple of times regarding the problem, I was contacted by one of the principals of the company to apologize for the delay and lack of contact and the system arrived within a week after that phone call. I intend to purchase more exhaust systems from Fabspeed in the future for some of our other cars, great product!!
